_comment: ATIVE UAS Bot - Manual File Upload Version
name: ATIVE UAS Bot - Manual
author: support@ative.com
description: UAS Bot with manual file upload - bypasses all git/network issues

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Manual UAS Bot Installation - No Git Required
echo "=== MANUAL UAS BOT INSTALLATION ==="

# Install system dependencies
apt update
apt install -y curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev python3-pip
apt install -y libcairo2-dev libpango1.0-dev libjpeg-dev libgif-dev librsvg2-dev pkg-config
apt install -y default-mysql-client

# Update npm
echo "Updating npm..."
npm install npm@latest --location=global

# Prepare directory
echo "Preparing installation directory..."
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Create placeholder files for manual upload
echo "Ready for manual file upload."
echo "Please upload the UAS bot files via the File Manager."
echo "Expected files: index.js, package.json, UTILS/, COMMANDS/, EVENTS/, etc."

# Create basic package.json if not uploaded
if [ ! -f "/mnt/server/package.json" ]; then
    echo "Creating basic package.json..."
    cat > /mnt/server/package.json << 'EOF'
{
  "name": "ative-utility-security-bot",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "ATIVE Utility & Security Bot",
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node index.js",
    "deploy-commands": "node scripts/deploy-commands.js"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "discord.js": "^14.14.1",
    "dotenv": "^16.3.1",
    "mysql2": "^3.6.5",
    "winston": "^3.11.0",
    "node-cron": "^3.0.3",
    "ms": "^2.1.3"
  },
  "optionalDependencies": {
    "canvas": "^2.11.2"
  }
}
EOF
fi

# Install dependencies
echo "Installing Node.js dependencies..."
npm install

# Create logs directory
mkdir -p logs

echo "=== Manual Installation Ready ==="
echo "Upload your UAS bot files and restart the server."
exit 0
